question: 1. Observations and variables forms:
options: Cases
Features
Data table
None of the above
explanation: الملاحظات (Observations) والمتحولات (Variables) تشكّل جدول البيانات (Data table).

question: 2. Observations is:
options: Columns
Variables
Raws
Rows
explanation: الملاحظات (Observations) هي الصفوف (Rows) في جدول البيانات.

question: 3. Data could be information collected:
options: At same time
Many times
A & B
None of the above
explanation: البيانات قد تُجمع في نفس الوقت (cross-section) أو عدة مرات (time series)، أي A وB.

question: 4. If some cross-sectional units are observed more times than others:
options: It is balanced data
It is unbalanced data
It is not possible to be achieved
None of the above
explanation: إذا شوهدت بعض الوحدات أكثر من غيرها فالبيانات غير متوازنة (unbalanced).

question: 5. Data quality is more related to data visualization not data analysis:
options: yes
no
explanation: جودة البيانات ترتبط بتحليل البيانات وليس بالتصوير فقط، فالعبارة خاطئة.

question: 6. The way of collecting data is not relevant to data quality:
options: yes
no
explanation: طريقة جمع البيانات ترتبط بجودتها، فالعبارة خاطئة.

question: 7. Quality of data is related to:
options: Validity
Reliability
Coverage
Content
All of the above
explanation: جودة البيانات ترتبط بالصلاحية والموثوقية والتغطية والمحتوى.

question: 9. Coverage is:
options: what is the substance a variable captures
how close the actual content of the variable to the intended content
If we were to measure the same variable multiple times for the same
What proportion of the observations in focus are in the data
explanation: التغطية (Coverage) هي نسبة الملاحظات المقصودة الموجودة فعلياً في البيانات.

question: 8. Content is:
options: what is the substance a variable captures
how close the actual content of the variable to the intended content
If we were to measure the same variable multiple times for the same
What proportion of the observations in focus are in the data
explanation: المحتوى (Content) هو ما يمثله المتحول (جوهره).

question: 10. Validity is:
options: what is the substance a variable captures
how close the actual content of the variable to the intended content
If we were to measure the same variable multiple times for the same
What proportion of the observations in focus are in the data
explanation: الصلاحية (Validity) هي مدى قرب المحتوى الفعلي للمتحول من المحتوى المقصود.

question: 12. Collecting data from existing sources is the best choice:
options: Because it is inexpensive
Because validity of main variables is high
it is not the best choice
Both A & B
explanation: البيانات من مصادر موجودة رخيصة لكن صلاحية المتحولات الرئيسية غالباً منخفضة، فليست دائماً الخيار الأفضل.

question: 13. GDPR stands for:
options: General data production resource
Genetic data programming responsibility
General data protection regulation
Global domain power resources
explanation: GDPR هي General Data Protection Regulation.

question: 14. Data must be processed legally, in a transparent manner:
options: Lawful
Fair
Transparent
All of the above
explanation: المعالجة القانونية الشفافة تعني Lawful وFair وTransparent معاً.

question: 15. Data Minimization:
options: Only collect and process the data strictly necessary to achieve the specific purpose.
Data should only be used for the specific, explicit purpose for which it was collected.
When personal data is collected directly, it must be based on a clear, freely given
تتمة الي فوق, and informed affirmative act
All of the above
explanation: تقليل البيانات (Data Minimization): جمع ومعالجة البيانات الضرورية للغرض المحدد فقط.

question: 16. Purpose Limitation:
options: Only collect and process the data strictly necessary to achieve the specific purpose.
Data should only be used for the specific, explicit purpose for which it was collected.
When personal data is collected directly, it must be based on a clear, freely given
, and informed affirmative act.تتمة فوق
None of the above
explanation: تحديد الغرض (Purpose Limitation): استخدام البيانات فقط للغرض المحدد المعلن عند جمعها.

question: 17. Informed Consent:
options: Only collect and process the data strictly necessary to achieve the specific purpose
Data should only be used for the specific, explicit purpose for which it was collected.
When personal data is collected directly, it must be based on a clear, freely given,
and informed affirmative act.
None of the above
explanation: الموافقة المستنيرة: يجب أن تكون حرة وواضحة ومبنية على إقرار مُطّلع (تتمة الخيار D).

question: 18. Data Subject Rights:
options: Integrate data protection mechanisms into technology and processes from the outset.
Integrate data protection mechanisms without technology and processes from the outset.
Subjects have the right to access, rectify, erase ("right to be forgotten")
, and object to the processing of their dataتتمة فوقها
None of the above
explanation: حقوق صاحب البيانات: الوصول والتصحيح والمحو (الحق في النسيان) والاعتراض (تتمة الخيار D).

question: 19. Discovery:
options: Do I have enough information to draft an analytic plan
Do I have enough "good data" to start building model
Do I have good idea about the type of model to try?
Can I refine the analytic plan?
explanation: مرحلة الاستكشاف (Discovery): هل لدي معلومات كافية لصياغة خطة تحليلية؟

question: 20. Model planning:
options: Do I have enough information to draft an analytic plan
Do I have enough "good data" to start building model
Do I have good idea about the type of model to try?
None of the above
explanation: مرحلة تخطيط النموذج: هل لدي فكرة جيدة عن نوع النموذج الذي سأجرّبه؟

question: 21. Data prep.:
options: Do I have enough information to draft an analytic plan
Do I have enough "good data" to start building model
Do I have good idea about the type of model to try?
Can I refine the analytic plan?
explanation: مرحلة تحضير البيانات: هل لدي بيانات جيدة كافية لبدء بناء النموذج؟

question: 22. Descriptive:
options: Deals with what happened in the past
Deals with why it did happened in the past
Deals with what will happen in the future
How can we make it happen again
explanation: التحليل الوصفي (Descriptive) يجيب عن ماذا حدث في الماضي.

question: 23. Predictive:
options: Deals with what happened in the past
Deals with why it did happened in the past
Deals with what will happen in the future
How can we make it happen again
explanation: التحليل التنبؤي (Predictive) يجيب عن ماذا سيحدث في المستقبل.

question: 24. Perspective (Prescriptive):
options: Deals with what happened in the past
Deals with why it did happened in the past
Deals with what will happen in the future
How can we make it happen again
explanation: التحليل الإرشادي (Prescriptive) يجيب عن كيف نجعله يحدث (أو نتعامل معه).

question: 25. Diagnostics:
options: Deals with what happened in the past
Deals with why it did happened in the past
Deals with what will happen in the future
How can we make it happen again
explanation: التحليل التشخيصي (Diagnostic) يجيب عن لماذا حدث ما حدث في الماضي.

question: 26. Feature engineering:
options: Perform data visualization and summary statistics to gain insights.
Consider techniques like one-hot encoding, scaling, and dimensionality reduction
Identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in the data.
Formulate initial hypotheses
explanation: هندسة الخصائص تتضمن تقنيات مثل one-hot encoding والتطبيع وتقليل الأبعاد.

question: 27. Simpson’s Paradox occurs due to the missing of lurking or confounding variables.
options: True
False
explanation: مفارقة سيمبسون تحدث بسبب إغفال متغيرات كامنة أو مربكة (confounding).

question: 28. Deals with aggregating larger datasets into smaller ones:
options: Simpson’s Paradox
Shannon's Paradox
Chomsky's Paradox
None of the above
explanation: مفارقة سيمبسون تظهر عند تجميع بيانات كبيرة في مجموعات أصغر أو العكس، فتنعكس الاتجاهات.

question: 29. Moving average is only used in finance and technical analysis:
options: True
False
explanation: المتوسط المتحرك لا يقتصر على المالية، فهو يُستخدم في الإشارات والإحصاء وغيرها.

question: 30. Moving average is used to filter the noise of long term random price fluctuations:
options: True
False
explanation: المتوسط المتحرك يرشّح ضوضاء التقلبات العشوائية قصيرة المدى وليس طويلة المدى.

question: 31. SMA calculates the arithmetic mean of a set of prices over a specific period:
options: True
False
explanation: SMA هو المتوسط الحسابي لمجموعة أسعار خلال فترة محددة.

question: 32. What is the best description of data mining?
options: A method for manually cleaning raw data before analysis
A database design technique for storing large tables efficiently.
The automatic extraction of implicit, potentially useful information from data.
A way of replacing all statistical analysis with visualization.
explanation: تنقيب البيانات هو الاستخراج التلقائي لمعلومات ضمنية ومفيدة محتملة من البيانات.

question: 33. Which pairing is most accurate for the main early distinction?
options: Labelled data and unlabelled data.
Structured data and encrypted data
Training data and test data only.
Static data and archived data.
explanation: التمييز المبكر الأدق هو بين البيانات الموسومة (labelled) وغير الموسومة.

question: 34. A dataset contains a designated attribute whose value is categorical, and the goal is to predict that value for unseen cases. What task is this?
options: Clustering
Regression
Classification
Association rule mining.
explanation: التنبؤ بقيمة تصنيفية (categorical) لحالات جديدة هو مهمة تصنيف (Classification).

question: 35. Which statement best captures supervised learning?
options: It uses unlabelled data to discover hidden groupings
It uses labelled data to learn a model for predicting a designated attribute.
It requires no training examples.
It only applies to numerical prediction.
explanation: التعلم الخاضع للإشراف يستخدم بيانات موسومة لبناء نموذج يتنبأ بخاصية محددة.

question: 36. Which of the following is the closest example of unsupervised learning?
options: Predicting a student’s final grade from previous grades.
Estimating house prices from known house features.
Classifying emails as spam or not spam using labelled examples.
Grouping customer records into natural clusters without predefined class labels.
explanation: تجميع سجلات الزبائن لعناقيد طبيعية دون تسميات مسبقة هو تعلم غير خاضع للإشراف.

question: 37. For data mining applications, which list is the most complete?
options: Classification, numerical prediction, association, and clustering.
Sorting, indexing, compression, and encryption.
Search, retrieval, replication, and backup.
Parsing, compilation, linking, and execution.
explanation: تطبيقات التنقيب: التصنيف والتنبؤ الرقمي والارتباط والتجميع.

question: 38. What is the role of an "instance" as a terminology?
options: A type of algorithm used in classification.
A set of variable values corresponding to one object or record.
A special kind of class label.
A measure of model accuracy.
explanation: الـ instance هي مجموعة قيم متحولات تقابل كائناً أو سجلاً واحداً.

question: 39. Why data mining is useful across many fields?
options: Because it only works on financial data.
Because it eliminates the need for domain knowledge.
Because it helps extract useful knowledge from data in diverse application areas.
Because it is mainly a database administration tool.
explanation: التنقيب مفيد في مجالات كثيرة لأنه يستخرج معرفة مفيدة من البيانات في تطبيقات متنوعة.

question: 40. Which example best fits nearest neighbour matching?
options: Building a rule set from frequent itemsets only.
Splitting data into entropy-balanced subsets.
Estimating coefficients in a linear equation.
Assigning a new case based on the labels of its closest examples.
explanation: مطابقة أقرب الجيران تعني إسناد حالة جديدة اعتماداً على تسميات أقرب أمثلتها.

question: 41. Which statement is most consistent what you learnt?
options: It is aimed only at advanced mathematicians.
It explains techniques with worked examples and limited mathematical formality.
It avoids exercises to keep the text concise.
It focuses mainly on programming implementation details.
explanation: الكتاب يشرح التقنيات بأمثلة محلولة وبصياغة رياضية محدودة.

question: 42. What is the primary purpose of entropy in decision tree learning?
options: To measure the number of features in a dataset.
To measure impurity or uncertainty in a class distribution.
To count the depth of the tree.
To compute the number of leaves in the tree
explanation: الإنتروبي تقيس عدم النقاء أو عدم اليقين في توزيع الأصناف.

question: 43. Which frequency table is typically used to compute entropy for a class attribute in a decision tree?
options: A table showing each class label and its count.
A table showing only attribute names
A table listing all test cases in order
A table of tree branches and pruning levels.
explanation: جدول تكراري يوضح كل صنف وعدده يُستخدم لحساب إنتروبي خاصية الصنف.

question: 44. If all instances in a node belong to the same class, the entropy of that node is:
options: Undefined
Maximum
explanation: إذا انتمت كل حالات العقدة لنفس الصنف تكون الإنتروبي 0 (عقدة نقية).

question: 45. Which split criterion is most closely associated with choosing the attribute that reduces uncertainty the most?
options: Accuracy
Gain ratio
Information gain
Recall
explanation: معيار الانقسام المرتبط بأكبر تقليل لعدم اليقين هو كسب المعلومات (Information gain).

question: 46. In decision tree induction, what does a root node usually represent?
options: The final class decision.
The first attribute test applied to the data.
The most frequent class only
A pruned subtree.
explanation: عقدة الجذر تمثل أول اختبار على خاصية يُطبَّق على البيانات.

question: 47. A frequency table for attribute Outlook in a some dataset would be used mainly to:
options: Estimate tree height
Compute entropy for each Outlook value and its class distribution.
Calculate the number of test records.
Determine the number of class labels in the dataset.
explanation: الجدول التكراري لـ Outlook يُستخدم لحساب إنتروبي كل قيمة وتوزيع أصنافها.

question: 48. Which of the following is most likely to produce the lowest entropy?
options: A 50/50 class split.
A highly mixed class distribution.
A node where one class dominates strongly.
A node with many different attributes
explanation: أقل إنتروبي في عقدة يهيمن فيها صنف واحد بقوة (شبه نقية).

question: 49. Which situation indicates a classifier with high accuracy but possibly poor class balance handling?
options: It predicts all classes equally well.
It performs well on the majority class but poorly on a minority class.
It has zero false positives and zero false negatives
It never makes any predictions
explanation: دقة عالية مع ضعف معالجة توازن الأصناف: أداء جيد على الصنف الأغلب وضعيف على الأقل.

question: 50. Why can accuracy be misleading in some classification problems?
options: It ignores all true negatives
It may look high when one class dominates the dataset.
It cannot be computed from a confusion matrix.
It is only used for regression.
explanation: الدقة قد تضلل لأنها تبدو مرتفعة عندما يهيمن صنف واحد على البيانات.

question: 51. In a binary classification confusion matrix, which outcome is a false positive?
options: Predicted positive, actually negative
Predicted negative, actually positive.
Predicted positive, actually positive.
Predicted negative, actually negative.
explanation: الإيجابي الكاذب (False positive): تنبأ بإيجابي والواقع سلبي.

question: 52. If a dataset node has class counts 9 positive and 1 negative, the entropy is
options: Close to 0.
Close to 1.
Exactly 1.
Negative
explanation: عقدة 9 موجب و1 سالب شبه نقية، فإنتروبيتها (≈0.47) أقرب للصفر.

question: 53. What does a leaf node in a decision tree usually represent?
options: An attribute test.
A final class prediction.
A missing value
A frequency table.
explanation: ورقة الشجرة تمثل التنبؤ النهائي بالصنف.

question: 54. When calculating information gain, what is subtracted from the parent entropy?
options: The depth of the tree.
The weighted entropy of the child subsets
The number of classes.
The number of records in the dataset.
explanation: كسب المعلومات = إنتروبي الأب − الإنتروبي الموزونة للمجموعات الفرعية.

question: 55. Which is the best reason to use a frequency table before computing entropy?
options: It allows direct measurement of class proportions
It replaces the need for training data.
It guarantees perfect accuracy.
It eliminates overfitting.
explanation: الجدول التكراري يتيح قياس نسب الأصناف مباشرة قبل حساب الإنتروبي.

question: 56. If a classifier predicts 80 instances correctly out of 100 total instances, its accuracy is:
57. Which property is most desirable for an attribute selected near the top of a decision tree?
options: It has the highest number of distinct values only.
It produces a strong reduction in class impurity
It is the least informative attribute
It appears in the smallest frequency table.
explanation: الخاصية المختارة قرب الجذر هي التي تخفض عدم نقاء الأصناف بشكل كبير.

question: 58. What does a decision tree ultimately do after a sequence of attribute tests?
options: Converts the data into a frequency table.
Assigns a class label at a leaf.
Computes entropy for the whole dataset only
Removes all noisy instances automatically.
explanation: شجرة القرار تُسند بعد سلسلة اختبارات الخصائص تسمية صنف عند ورقة.

question: 11. Unbiased selection:
options: If coverage incomplete the observations that are included in the data should be similar to all observations that were intended to be covered.
If coverage incomplete the observations that are included in the data must be similar to all observations that were intended to be covered.
If coverage complete the observations that are included in the data should be similar to all observations that were intended to be covered.
Not related to coverage
explanation: الاختيار غير المنحاز: حتى لو التغطية ناقصة، تكون الملاحظات المشمولة مشابهة للمقصودة (should).
